stem: Lower-leaf chlorosis appears after a nutrient-program change, but root-zone pH, EC, irrigation distribution, and root health have not been checked. What is the best next step?
choices: Increase nitrogen immediately based only on leaf color.
Collect root-zone and irrigation evidence before deciding whether the symptom reflects macronutrient supply, availability, or another stress.
Remove all lower leaves and make no measurements.
Assume every lower-leaf symptom has the same cause.
rationale: Macronutrient-like symptoms can overlap with pH, EC, irrigation, root, and environmental problems. Diagnostic evidence should precede correction.
